sloka: एतन्मे भगवन्सर्वं हनूमति महामतौ ।विस्तरेण यथातत्त्वं कथयामरपूजित ।। ७.३५.१३ ॥
transliteration: etanme bhagavansarvaṁ hanūmati mahāmatau ।vistareṇa yathātattvaṁ kathayāmarapūjita ।। 7.35.13 ॥

translations.english: O revered one, worshipped by gods, please tell me all about the great-minded Hanuman in detail and truly.
